what: E27 MERGED (#12729, 2026-09-22) AND CANNOT BE DEPLOYED, so the row it closes cannot close. Its change adds `ssh.service` to `_CANONICAL_UNITS` in src/web/api/routers/diag.py — code served by `ict-web-api.service`. MEASURED 2026-09-22 against the allowlist: `restart-bot-service` wraps scripts/ops/restart_bot.sh, whose `UNIT="ict-trader-live.service"` — it restarts THE TRADER, not the web API. `scripts/ops/restart_web_api.sh` EXISTS in the repo and names ict-web-api.service four times, but grep finds it in NEITHER docs/claude/system-actions.md NOR .github/workflows/system-actions.yml, so there is no dispatch path for it. [!] THE SHAPE OF THIS IS THE POINT AND IT GENERALISES BEYOND E27: any merged change to the web API's own code is UNDEPLOYABLE by a session today. `ict-git-sync` pulls main every ~5 min, so the FILE reaches the VM and the RUNNING PROCESS keeps the old code — which is precisely the merged-vs-deployed collapse E31 exists to make visible, arriving here as a concrete stranded change rather than a principle. [!] AND THE WORKAROUNDS ARE WORSE THAN THE GAP, stated so a later session does not reach for one: `reboot-vm` restarts everything including the live trader and needs a sudoers entry that may not exist; `fix-data-dir` and `set-env` restart the web API as a SIDE EFFECT of doing something else, so using either as a restart vector means dispatching a mutation for its side effect — exactly the kind of off-label use the allowlist exists to prevent. Neither should be used for this. [!] WHAT THE FIX IS: add `restart-web-api` to the allowlist the way § 2 requires — the doc, the workflow's `inputs.action.options`, the wrapper mapping in system-actions.yml, and the priority case. Tier 2, single unit, restart-only, and the script it wraps already exists and already reads its pre/post is-active state.
